content.short: XBANKING Research is a free Web3 analytics platform with crypto news, insights, fundraising data, and market charts.
content.description: XBANKING Research delivers a free Web3 analytics platform that blends a crypto news aggregator with real-time insights and data on fundraising, airdrops, testnets, and grants. It also features an events calendar, a Web3 jobs board, an academy, a discussion forum, and market charts, along with additional resources. Users can track news as it happens and assess its potential impact on their investment decisions, helping shape strategies across multiple networks and projects.
